body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary magical Movement penalty until the start of your next turn; the target reduces its next incoming forced movement by 2 units.

surges.html: Also suppress one ordinary magical sensory penalty for the same duration.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it is targeted by the source of the suppressed Condition. Echo: gain +1 to the targeted Defense against that Action.
